blocks.title: Is hisse ka kuch hissa source mein maujood nahi
blocks.text: Scan shuda kitab mein chhapa hua safha 21 maujood nahi, is liye section 2.2 ki heading, ibtidai matan aur Figure 2.1 parhe nahi ja sakte. Yeh lesson sirf bache hue hisse use karta hai: agle safhe par section ka aakhri hissa, Figure 2.2, aur chapter ka apna khulasa aur mashq. Oopar ka unwan bayaniya hai, chhapi hui heading nahi.
Jo bacha hai: sahi tarteeb mein qadam

Bacha hua matan batata hai ke hal sahi tarteeb mein qadmon ki shakal mein likha jata hai. Is se masla hal karte hue ghaltiyan nahi hotin, aur koi bhi qadmon ko asani se samajh aur use kar sakta hai. Computers bhi qadam ba qadam hidayat par chalte hain (Fig 2.2), aur achhi mansooba bandi sahi nataij deti hai.

blocks.alt: Step-by-Step Algorithm Example ki heading ke neeche flowchart: Start, Boil Water (pani ubalein), Steep Tea (patti bhigoyein), Add Milk or Lemon (doodh ya lemon dalein), Serve Tea (chai pesh karein), End, teeron se jure. Saath mein ketli, tea bag wala cup, doodh, cheeni aur lemon, aur lemon wala cup.

Chapter ki mashq mein masla hal karne ke qadam

items: Masla pehchanein: mashq ise masla hal karne ka pehla qadam batati hai.
Masle ko chhote hisson mein torein (decomposition).
Hal ko algorithm ki shakal mein likhein: sahi tarteeb mein wazeh qadam.
Hal ko jaanchein aur behtar karein (agla lesson).

blocks.explanation: Decomposition bare masle ko aise chhote hisson mein torti hai jo aik aik kar ke hal ho sakein. Misal: school ka result sheet banana number jama karne, har talib-e-ilm ka total, percentage aur grade nikalne, aur sheet print karne mein baanta ja sakta hai; har hissa saada hai aur sab mil kar poora masla hal karte hain.

Decomposition: masle ko qabil-e-intizam hisson mein torna; algorithm: tarteeb-war qadam.
Sahi tarteeb ke qadam ghaltiyan rokte; computers unhein bilkul follow karte.
